title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Tunnel Frame Parser Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, fuzz-harness build coverage, BenchmarkDotNet dry-run coverage, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9220 WebSocket tunnel parser.
scope: This verification covers WebSocket frame parsing on RFC 9220 Extended CONNECT streams, masking enforcement by receiving endpoint role, unmasked message surfacing, fragmented data-message reassembly, split-input buffering, invalid continuation rejection, incomplete fragmented message rejection at end-of-stream, control-frame finality and payload-size validation, complete text-message UTF-8 validation, and close status/reason payload parsing.
preconditions: The RFC 9220 Extended CONNECT foundation remains trace-owned by `VER-QUIC-RFC9220-0001`.
The WebSocket parser remains in `Incursa.Quic.Http3` and does not mutate QUIC transport runtime state.
expected_result: The focused parser tests pass, fuzz and benchmark projects build or dry-run successfully, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9220 artifacts, generated triage reflects the trace-owned WebSocket parser requirements, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The RFC 9220 WebSocket tunnel parser, message reassembler, text UTF-8 validation, and close payload parser are trace-owned and locally verified. Application handler integration, tunnel forwarding, close-handshake policy, and live peer proof remain future local slices.
